6. After hearing the parties and considering the evidence on record the learned Subordinate Judge, Kishoregonj, by his judgment and decree dated 23-10-1989 allowed the claim of the plaintiffs to get saham in the suit property for an area of 0.708 acre, defendant No. 12 for 0.471 acre, and defendant Nos. 13, 16-18 for 0.36 acre of land. 

 7. Being aggrieved by the said judgment and decree defendant No. 2 preferred other Class Appeal No. 77 of 1990 before the Court of learned District Judge, Kishoregonj. On transfer, the learned Additional District Judge, 1st Court, Kishoregonj after hearing the appeal dismissed the same by his judgment and decree dated 15-1-1996. 

 8. Against the said judgment and decree passed by the appellate Court, defendant No. 2 as petitioner filed Civil Revision No. 2821 of 1997 before the High Court Division and obtained Rule. By the impugned judgment and order the High Court Division discharged the Rule. Hence, the defendant No. 2 has filed the instant civil petition for leave to appeal before this Division. 

 12. It appears from the judgment of the appellate Court that the instant petitioner as defendant No. 2 took four years to file the written statement but failed to be present at the peremptory hearing and the suit was decreed ex-parte against him.
